title: Define storage & retention rules

storageClasses.content: projects, prompts, lyrics drafts, private audio/stems, draft metadata
inactive/pinned private project artifacts awaiting expiry/export/deletion

retentionPolicies.deleteTrigger: earlier of job terminal cleanup when no longer needed or expiry
retentionPolicies.deletionSla: immediate on expiry/access; purge on next cleanup cycle
retentionPolicies.rule: 420Hz may request a shorter period but never a longer provider-runtime private-payload lifetime

retentionPolicies.deleteTrigger: terminal lifecycle plus no explicit user save/export/legal hold
retentionPolicies.deletionSla: primary private bytes deleted within 24 hours after retention expiry; replicas within 7 days; backups within 30 days
retentionPolicies.rule: failed/cancelled data must not silently become long-lived project storage

retentionPolicies.maxRetention: 30 days after generation unless explicitly saved/pinned into an active project
retentionPolicies.deletionSla: primary within 24 hours; replicas within 7 days; backups within 30 days
retentionPolicies.rule: selected/pinned artifacts may move to active-project retention

retentionPolicies.maxRetention: 365 days after last authenticated project activity unless refreshed by user activity/export/save policy
retentionPolicies.deleteTrigger: 365 days inactivity, explicit delete, or account/project closure
retentionPolicies.deletionSla: logical access disabled immediately; primary bytes within 24 hours; replicas within 7 days; backups within 30 days
retentionPolicies.rule: warn/notify before inactivity expiry where notification capability is available; no automatic public transition

retentionPolicies.deleteTrigger: archive grace expiry or explicit delete
retentionPolicies.deletionSla: primary/archive bytes within 24 hours after grace expiry; replicas within 7 days; backups within 30 days
retentionPolicies.rule: archive is a deletion grace tier, not indefinite storage

retentionPolicies.deletionSla: primary within 24 hours of expiry; no backup required
retentionPolicies.rule: export URLs/tokens are single-purpose, time-bounded and access-controlled

retentionPolicies.maxRetention: 30 days after the gated action completes unless a live dispute/evidence hold requires longer
retentionPolicies.deleteTrigger: retention expiry, source revocation, or explicit delete where policy permits
retentionPolicies.deletionSla: primary within 24 hours; replicas within 7 days; backups within 30 days
retentionPolicies.rule: prefer qualified external consent references/commitments over copying raw evidence

appliesTo: private evidence needed for an accepted challenge/appeal
retentionPolicies.maxRetention: through the canonical challenge/appeal window plus 30 days
retentionPolicies.deleteTrigger: finality plus 30-day post-resolution grace, unless another binding legal/policy hold applies
retentionPolicies.deletionSla: primary/archive within 24 hours after hold expiry; replicas within 7 days; backups within 30 days
retentionPolicies.rule: hold is case-scoped and cannot retain unrelated project payloads

retentionPolicies.deleteTrigger: age expiry unless active incident/dispute requires a scoped hold
retentionPolicies.deletionSla: delete/compact within 7 days after expiry; backups within 30 days
retentionPolicies.rule: must not contain protected raw payloads, credentials or private media

retentionPolicies.deletionSla: hidden immediately; primary bytes within 24 hours where feasible; replicas within 7 days; backups within 30 days
retentionPolicies.rule: public derived projections must stop presenting deleted private state immediately

appliesTo: published artwork/stems only when intentionally published
retentionPolicies.maxRetention: while canonical publication/storage agreement remains active or until withdrawal/depublication policy applies
retentionPolicies.deletionSla: implementation-specific to owning canonical storage agreement; 420Hz must stop serving immediately when canonical availability says unavailable
retentionPolicies.rule: 420Hz does not claim deletion authority over storage it does not own

retentionPolicies.deleteTrigger: none for immutable canonical history; mutable presentation may hide/restrict where canonical policy allows
retentionPolicies.rule: user deletion of private bytes must never be misrepresented as deletion of immutable canonical commitments/history

immediateEffects: revoke application access and public/private serving paths immediately
issue a tombstone/deletion marker for application-controlled objects
revoke provider/storage access grants where controlled by 420Hz
stop Search/Indexer/Notifications from presenting deleted private/unlisted state
boundedPhysicalDeletion: provider execution payloads: <=24h absolute maximum and preferably earlier
exceptions: independently controlled external systems with their own authoritative retention
case-scoped dispute/evidence hold through accepted challenge/appeal period plus 30d
lawful/binding external retention obligations, which must be separately documented rather than silently extending ordinary retention
antiResurrection: deletion/tombstone wins over stale cache, replica, retry, replay and restore
restored backups must reapply deletion/tombstone ledger before objects become readable
Indexer/Search rebuilds must not resurrect objects whose source state is deleted/private/unlisted
provider retry must not restore expired private payloads from local state
recreated content receives a new object/version identity unless canonical object semantics explicitly require restoration

quotaRules: quota accounting is per account/project and separates private primary bytes, archived bytes and published-media references
configured byte/count limits remain deployment configuration and are not invented as protocol constants in HZ-GCA-1.8
before generation/upload would exceed quota, fail closed or require explicit cleanup/plan change; never silently discard unrelated saved work
failed/cancelled/expired data is eligible for cleanup before active saved/pinned project data
published canonical media/history is never silently deleted merely to satisfy a private-project quota
user-visible usage must distinguish storage actually controlled by 420Hz from external canonical storage references
archiveExportRules: archive is private, encrypted and time-bounded
export must include user-owned 420Hz project metadata and eligible private artifacts plus canonical reference IDs/commitments where useful
export does not disclose provider credentials, wallet secrets, unrelated users' private data or inaccessible source evidence
export package access is authenticated and expires within 24h
archive/export does not create public visibility or new rights
providerRules: 420AI EncryptedPayloadStore420 maxRetentionMs defaults to 24h and rejects longer requested expiry windows
420Hz must not configure provider private payload retention above the qualified provider-runtime maximum
provider runtime plaintext is not persisted in workflow state
payload access is assignment scoped and expiration deletes/denies access
provider/state recovery may retain non-secret signed manifests/receipts/commitments for idempotency without retaining plaintext inputs
terminal cleanup must prefer deletion as soon as the private payload is no longer needed for accepted verification/dispute semantics
storageAuthorityRules: 420Hz owns only application-controlled private project/archive/export stores and their deletion ledger
420ResourceProtocol/420Store or other canonical storage services retain authority over their own agreements, proofs and object references
a StorageObjectRef/manifest is a reference, not proof that 420Hz can physically delete all external replicas
published media deletion/availability follows the owning canonical storage/publication policy
immutable chain commitments and Creative IDs are historical references and are not deleted by private-data erasure
backupRecoveryRules: ordinary private backups expire within 30 days
restore procedures must replay deletion/tombstone state before serving restored objects
backups must preserve encryption and access controls equivalent to primary private storage
backups must not become a hidden retention bypass for provider payloads whose maximum is 24h
deletion receipts/metrics may be retained as redacted audit metadata without payload contents
failureRules: attempt to configure provider private-payload retention above 24h fails closed
expired provider payload access fails closed and triggers deletion
quota exhaustion cannot silently delete saved/pinned or published content
restore that cannot reconcile deletion/tombstone state fails closed before serving private objects
deletion request that cannot revoke serving/indexing visibility immediately is treated as degraded and must not report success
private payload retained beyond its applicable policy without a documented scoped hold is invalid
backup retention above 30 days for ordinary private application data is invalid absent a separately documented binding hold
Search/Indexer/Notifications resurrection of deleted private state is invalid
deletion of private application data cannot be represented as erasure of immutable public canonical history
invariants: HZGCA-STORE-001 provider private execution payload retention never exceeds the qualified 24-hour 420AI runtime maximum
HZGCA-STORE-002 failed/cancelled private generation payloads expire within 7 days absent explicit save/export/scoped hold
HZGCA-STORE-003 unsaved generated takes/stems expire within 30 days
HZGCA-STORE-004 active saved private projects expire after 365 days inactivity unless refreshed under explicit user policy
HZGCA-STORE-005 archive grace is bounded to 30 days and is not indefinite storage
HZGCA-STORE-006 generated export packages expire within 24 hours
HZGCA-STORE-007 application-controlled deletion revokes access immediately and removes primary private bytes within 24 hours, replicas within 7 days and ordinary backups within 30 days
HZGCA-STORE-008 backup restore cannot resurrect deleted/tombstoned private objects
HZGCA-STORE-009 Search/Indexer/Notifications cannot resurrect or broaden visibility of deleted/private/unlisted state
HZGCA-STORE-010 dispute/evidence retention is scoped to the accepted case/window plus a bounded 30-day post-finality grace
HZGCA-STORE-011 raw consent evidence is minimized and expires under bounded private retention unless a scoped hold applies
HZGCA-STORE-012 quota exhaustion never silently destroys saved/pinned work, canonical published media or immutable history
HZGCA-STORE-013 public published media follows canonical storage/publication authority rather than 420Hz inventing physical-deletion control
HZGCA-STORE-014 immutable provenance/disclosure/award/chain history survives private-byte deletion as historical commitments only
HZGCA-STORE-015 provider recovery may preserve nonsecret commitments/receipts but not revive expired plaintext payloads
HZGCA-STORE-016 private backups preserve encryption/access controls and never bypass the provider 24-hour payload maximum
HZGCA-STORE-017 retention/deletion receipts and security metadata contain no protected payload contents
HZGCA-STORE-018 storage/retention policy creates no new rights, identity, payment, governance, storage-provider or protocol authority
exitCriteria: storage tiers and authority boundaries are explicit
quota, archive and export behavior is explicit
canonical public-history and external-storage deletion exceptions are explicit without overclaiming authority
machine verifier enforces bounded durations, provider 24h maximum, deletion SLAs and anti-resurrection invariants
no ABI, deployment, live provider or testnet state is invented
HZ-GCA-1 remains open for HZ-GCA-1.9 through HZ-GCA-1.20
